verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a first-party doc page titled "Perform Access Review for a Critical System", and its integrations map users with access to connected systems and check offboarding. That shows an in-platform access review capability tied to integrated apps, but the pack contains only page titles and integration blurbs, with no detail on the review workflow itself. missing for 10: evidence of periodic/recurring review scheduling, in-app reviewer sign-off workflow, reviews spanning multiple connected apps (only a single critical system is named), the review artifact automatically landing in the evidence library, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: Perform Access Review for a Critical System
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
